rationale: M37.21 #610 master review (user-suspect wave). Pins TWO contracts: (1) JD18 - an anonymous class body (new Comparator<String>() {...}) declares a Class symbol anonymous_<Super> owned by the enclosing type, and its methods attribute to the ANONYMOUS type (contains anonymous_Comparator->compare), never to the enclosing class (the pre-fix bug leaked contains:Service->compare and fabricated no anonymous symbol). (2) JD19 - override resolution walks MULTI-HOP nested-class chains through non-declaring ancestors (BlackVal extends Black extends Node: BlackVal.val overrides Node.val even though Black declares no val), via suffix-resolved hierarchy lookup with symbolMap disambiguation. M37.21 C30: the anonymous type registers its SUPERTYPE in classHierarchy, so an @Override method inside the anon body resolves exact-in-file (anonymous_Handler.handle -> Handler.handle) instead of falling out with no edge. External-supertype anon bodies (Comparator/Runnable) stay override-free — truth is in-file.
